title: Privacy, Narrative, and Public Export Separation
negative_results: a PRIVATE record is refused from a public export bundle (ExportError)
a private path/identity token in any field, including nested dicts and lists, is refused by the recursive scan
the exported payload never carries a private field (narrative, prediction, personal_location, operator_name, raw_vector_string, ...)
assert_export_clean rejects any bundle item that is not PUBLIC_SYNTHETIC

claims.statement: A public export/audit bundle carries only synthetic/public, redacted content; assembly reuses privacy.assert_exportable and privacy.refuse_private_in_public and scans every field (POWER).

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic public fixtures only; private records and private tokens are refused, not shipped
